name: Village Idiot
ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn their alignment. [+0 to +2 Village Idiots. 1 of the extras is drunk]
designRole: Recurring chosen alignment information, with optional extra copies and a drunk extra.
explanation: Recurring chosen alignment information, with optional extra copies and a drunk extra.

nightInstructions.firstNight: If there are multiple Village Idiots, mark one as *DRUNK*. :reminder: Wake the Village Idiots one at a time to choose a player. Give a thumb signal.
nightInstructions.otherNights: Wake the Village Idiots one at a time to choose a player. Give a thumb signal.

storytellerNotes: Extra Village Idiots may be in play with one extra drunk. Script record count is not an in-play multiplicity simulator.

jinxes.reason: If there is a spare token, the Boffin can give the Demon the Village Idiot ability.
If there is a spare token, the Pit-Hag can create an extra Village Idiot. If so, the drunk Village Idiot might change.
